name: Model kit
promptTemplate: Make a one color plastic model-kit sprue card of this scene. Pick a prominent vibrant color from the scene to use. Keep people and animals in one piece. Make the background a darker shade of the sprue card.
promptHints: Detailed, full body photo of a person in the foreground, with a vibrant scene in the background

exampleImages.alt: A green plastic model-kit sprue holds a person, city skyline, streetlamp, bicycle, and planter.
